description: Reads one frame of documentId related to the m.room.create event anchor: unrelated (skipped), invalid (the document can no longer be trusted), or the frame with its data in base64.

cases.name: an update frame
a chunk frame
a commit frame
another event type is unrelated
an undecryptable event is unrelated here
a frame of another anchor is unrelated
a frame with a thread relation is unrelated
a frame of another document is unrelated
a frame without a document is unrelated
a redacted frame is invalid
a frame without a sender is invalid
version 2 is invalid
an update id with a space is invalid
an empty update id is invalid
an update id of 128 characters is valid
an update id of 129 characters is invalid
an update id may use dots, dashes and underscores
zero chunks is invalid
256 chunks is valid
257 chunks is invalid
an unknown kind is invalid
an update frame of two chunks is invalid
a chunk frame of one chunk is invalid
an update frame must be chunk 0
a chunk index must be below the count
a negative chunk index is invalid
a string chunk index is invalid
a fractional chunk count is invalid
cases.note: The web client checks Number.isInteger, which also accepts 1.0.

a commit with a chunk index is invalid
a commit of one chunk is invalid
a frame without data is invalid
